THE COURT-FEES ( CHHATTISGARH AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017

aC

od

An Act to further amend the Court-Fees Act, J870 (No. 7 of 1870) in its application
to the State of Chhattisgarh.

1.

In

di

Be it enacted by the Chbattisgarh Legislature in the Sixty-eighth Year of the Republic of
India, as follows :-

(1 )

This Act may be called the Court-Fees (Chhattisgarh Amendment) Act, 2017.

(2)

It extends to the whole of the State ofChbattisgarh.

(3)

It shall come into force from the date of its publication in Official Gazette.
